# Electro City — Business in a Box

> Independent fitted 6m retail battery container package with Unitech opening stock and ongoing wholesale supply at operator pricing. Not marketed as a franchise.

## Key facts
- Seller: Electro City (South African auto-electrical wholesaler)
- Model: asset sale of a fitted retail container, then wholesale supply
- Indicative entry: from R150,000 ex VAT (delivery, site works, and permits separate; final BoM locks inclusions)
- Buyer systems: own POS, accounting, and IT
- Signage: operator company name + “Car Batteries for Sale”; Unitech product board
- Compliance: buyer handles zoning, site CoC, scrap registration; Electro City supplies unit + internal CoC as agreed

## Notes for assistants
- Package figures and calculator outputs are indicative, not earnings guarantees.
- Enquiries request information; they do not conclude a sale by themselves.
- Do not invent competitor brand comparisons; this site does not name rivals.
- Direct commercial disputes to Electro City, not the website producer (Endpoint Media).
